newsitem.title: USA: Authorities identify body of missing 10-year-old.
newsitem.headline: Authorities identify body of missing 10-year-old.

text.p: Authorities on Sunday identified the body of a boy found in a shallow grave in a remote area of the desert as 10-year-old Anthony Martinez, who had been missing since April 4.

The boy, kidnapped at knifepoint from an alley behind his home, was found late on Saturday by a park ranger in rugged terrain near Indio, California, a small community about 100 miles east of Los Angeles in Riverside County.
"The coroner has concluded the body is that of Anthony Martinez," officials of the Riverside County Sheriff's department said at a news conference.

The ranger who found the child was led to the site after spotting several vultures circling in the sky in a hilly section of the desert. He saw Martinez's head and arms protruding from a shallow grave coverd by sand and rocks.
A cause of death was still unknown pending the completion of a coroner's autopsy, according to local news reports.

Martinez's disappearance sparked a massive search around his hometown of Beaumont, California, in which volunteers distributed thousands of fliers describing the boy and his alleged abductor. The suspect was described as having a moustache and piercing blue eyes, and remains at large.
